PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Experience of the bidder should be at least 3 years in providing the similar manpower supply services. 2. Bidder should have supplied similar category of services for similar or higher quantities as indicated in t he bid document in at least one of last 3 years. 3. Bidder should have executed at least 1 single order of 80% value of bid or 2 orders each of 50% value of bid or 3 order each of 40% value of bid for similar services in last three years to Govt. 4. Annual turnover of the bidder should be more than 50% of the contract value. A certificate in this reg ard should be uploaded. 5. Office of the bidder must be located in Delhi.

6. As per Department of Expenditure, M/o Finance OM No. F/9/4/2020-PPD dated 12.11.2020 on the subject "Bid Security/Earnest Money Deposit", bidders are required to submit Bid Security Declaration whi ch should contain the following: Bid Securing Declaration (BSD): In lieu of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)/Bid Security, bidders shall sub mit a duly signed Bid Securing Declaration on their official letterhead, in accordance with Rule 170(iii) of G FR, 2017, incorporating the following undertakings: (i) the bid shall not be withdrawn or modified during th e stipulated bid validity period, including any extension agreed to in writing; (ii) in the event of award of th e contract, the bidder shall execute the Contract Agreement and furnish the requisite Performance Security within the prescribed timelines; and (iii) any breach of these obligations shall render the bidder liable to su spension from participating in bids/proposals for contracts floated by the Ministry of External Affairs fo r a period of two (2) years, commencing from the date of issuance of the suspension order by the comp etent authority. The declaration shall clearly mention the bid number, title, date, name of the bidding firm, and details of the authorised signatory, including signature, name, designation and company seal/stamp. T he BSD shall remain valid for the entire bid validity period, including any extension agreed to in writing, an d until the applicable obligations under the declaration have been fulfilled. The bidder shall also undertake to comply with the Code of Integrity for Public Procurement under Rule 175 of GFR, 2017 and other applica ble provisions of the tender document. Failure to submit a duly executed declaration containing the above undertakings may render the bid liable for rejection. 7. After awarding the contract, it will be considered effective only after receipt of Performance Bank Gu arantee from the qualified Service Provider. 8. The Service Provider should supply the manpower having police clearance certificate/PCC. Only those ca ndidates will be accepted who meet the eligibility criteria and who have PCC and Service Provider’s ap pointment letter with them. 9. The Service Provider shall enter into agreement with the outsourced staff informing them about the obligations, benefits, responsibilities and all the relevant information. 10. The contract can be terminated by giving one month’s notice during the contract period. 11. The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25% at th e time of issue of contract or during the currency of contract. . 10. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
